summary: Analyse connected exposures, portfolio concentrations and stress scenarios. Build practical limit and committee-reporting skills. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: Credit risk concentration training helps credit analysts and managers assess how connected exposures can create shared portfolio vulnerabilities. For credit and portfolio-risk professionals, it develops skills in exposure aggregation and classification checks, limit monitoring, concentration scenario analysis, Excel-based portfolio review, and preparing escalation records and committee reports.
audienceIntro: Credit concentration work sits across exposure analysis, portfolio oversight and decisions about risk appetite. This advanced course is designed for professionals who already handle credit exposures and need a more rigorous way to identify connected risks, monitor limits and brief decision-makers.
prerequisites: Advanced course. Prior experience in credit risk, credit portfolio analysis or exposure monitoring is expected. Working familiarity with credit exposure data, portfolio limits and spreadsheet analysis will support the exercises. No programming is required.
